title: ProposalSet
description: Several things an agent proposes at once — the evening's tidying, a week's plan, what a document said — each ticked or not by the person, applied together by one gesture, and undone together (doctrine D-051). Nothing in it is true until applied: each item names the gesture that will make it true, with its level.

origin.description: closure: the evening's note. plan: a plan of the day or the week. intake: what was received. agent: an agent's run.

gesture.description: postpone, close, block (a time), assign (to a colleague, who may refuse), correct (a record), remind, lesson (proposed to a skill's owner), create.

label.description: What will happen, as the person reads it.

reason.description: Why it is proposed, in a sentence.

level.description: The autonomy level of the gesture that applies it (1 to 4).

capability.description: The capability that applies it, when an app does.

ticked.description: Whether it is ticked when shown; the person changes it.
